svg.title: Arcel database schema
svg.desc: All thirteen application and authentication tables, with every column and foreign-key relationship. The hierarchy runs top to bottom from auth.users through profiles to dependent records. Colored arrows point from referenced parent records to child tables. Light gray outer connectors link profiles.id to every user_id foreign key.
svg.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · PK,FK both
Gray lines: profile ownership through user_id
